sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Romeshwari Prasad

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mahendra Kumar Maurya Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
List revised.
Heard Sri Romeshwari Prasad, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Mahendra Kumar Maurya,
learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2, Sri S.B. Maurya, learned counsel for the State and perused the records.
Office is directed to trace out the vakalatnama of Sri Mahendra Kumar Maurya and place it on record and make a note about it in the order sheet.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Zahid,
Smt.Naima@Basso and Shahid, with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings along with charge sheet dated 20.6.2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, against the Zahid And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193157132/
1 applicant no. 1 and 2, and under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act against the applicant no.3, arising out of Case Crime No. 22 of 2020, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Meerut and all its consequential proceedings on the basis of compromise between the parties dated 29.9.2022.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that it is common ground between the parties that the parties have settled the dispute amicably out of court.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has placed annexure no. 5 to the affidavit in support of this application, which is copy of compromise dated 29.9.2022.

It is further argued that an order dated 13.8.2022 was passed by the Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C. (Crime Against Women), Meerut by which the case filed by the opposite party no. 2 under the Domestic Violence Act has been withdrawn by her.
Copy of the said order has been placed before the Court which is annexed at page-66 of the paper book (annexure no. 6 to the affidavit).

It is argued that the opposite party no. 2 is not interested to pursue the matter pending in the lower court and is not inclined to give any evidence against the applicant and therefore the impugned proceedings be quashed on the ground of compromise between the parties.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 admits the arguments of learned counsel for the applicants and states that he has no objection if the impugned proceeding pending against the applicants is quashed.
The law with regards to quashing of a case on the basis of settlement arrived between the parties, is well settled.

The Apex Court in the cases of (1) B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another: (2003)4 SCC 675; (2) Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation : (2008) 9 SCC 677; (3) Manoj Sharma Vs. State and others: ( 2008) 16 SCC 1; (4) Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab:
(2012) 10 SCC 303; (5) Shaifullah and others Vs. State of U.P. And another: 2013 (83) ACC 278 and (6) Parbatbhai Ahir@Parbatbhai @ Bhimsinbhai Karmur and others Vs. State of Gujarat and another: (2017) 9 SCC 641 has held that the cases in which the parties have settled their grievances can be quashed.

sentences.text:
From perusal of the records and the law laid down by the Apex Court on the subject matter, the present case is a good case for exercising powers by this Court to quash the entire proceedings, the charge sheet and all consequential proceedigns as prayed for by the applicant(s).
The present application is allowed.
The proceedings of the case and the charge sheet are hereby quashed.
